# Vendored native ABC helper

`yue_abc.py` is an unmodified copy of `src/lyra/music_tools/abc_tools.py` from
https://github.com/vanch007/mlx-Yue/tree/9253ed133343406947bde7b67d43c7a63fb39d99
(Apache-2.0; full license retained as `LICENSE.mlx-Yue`). It implements the limited
native YuE two-voice dialect, not general ABC validation. No inference models or
transcription vendor tree are copied into CanvasHub's backend.
